nodes.label: Rectangular Region mode reveals explicit geometry fields
nodes.rationale: Selecting 'Rectangular Region' as the Area exposes four numeric WxH+x+y fields (1249, 20, 686, 958) that are not needed for full-screen or per-monitor modes. Documenting this state shows the launcher's controls are mode-dependent: the region mode needs a precise, reproducible rectangle, so it offers typed coordinates in addition to interactive selection, letting users repeat an exact capture without re-dragging.
